content: We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule (which is protected with TBS) reproduces the reaction: removal of TBS to give free alcohol (aliphatic hydroxyl). So we need to find a template that breaks O-Si bond and forms O-H. The forward reaction: TBS protected alcohol + TBAF -> deprotected alcohol. So functional groups broken: t-butyldimethylsilyl (the protecting group). Formed: aliphatic hydroxyl. So we can search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_broken includes "t-butyldimethylsilyl"? Need to see available functional groups list. Use get_available_functional_groups.
